Persist an availability_status classification beside each online boolean while retaining the boolean as the consumer's primary availability gate.

Aggregate and update availability classifications in the existing per-source and per-master-ID shards without adding a database or monolithic status catalog.
Allow one authenticated security master to reference supported correlation generations during incremental correlation-rule migration.
